content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Lemon squeezy

Lemon Squeezy focuses on providing a straightforward platform for creators to sell digital products, but its availability is limited. Stripe, similarly, offers robust payment processing but is confined to a select number of countries. In contrast, sovereign commerce infrastructure like the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) enables creators to build their online stores using tools like Cloudflare Pages, Workers, and NOWPayments, without geographical restrictions. This approach allows for full ownership, no reliance on third-party platforms, and the ability to accept payments in over 300 cryptocurrencies. Ultimately, while Lemon Squeezy and Stripe provide certain functionalities, they do not cater to the global creator economy effectively.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Lemon Squeezy and Stripe both impose geographical restrictions that exclude many potential users in developing regions. For instance, a PayPal account suspension can freeze funds for up to 180 days with no recourse, adding uncertainty for creators trying to sell digital products. This non-inclusivity forces creators to seek alternatives. Sovereign commerce infrastructure circumvents these issues by utilizing decentralized payment methods and hosting solutions that are not limited by geography. By deploying tools like Google Apps Script and NOWPayments, creators can establish a fully functional store that operates independently of regional restrictions, ensuring their ability to engage in commerce globally.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

When it comes to payment processing, traditional platforms like Stripe and PayPal often impose high fees and delayed transactions. Stripe charges a percentage of each transaction and may not support all forms of payment in restricted countries. On the other hand, NOWPayments offers a low 0.5% fee with immediate on-chain payment confirmation, enabling instant access to funds. In regions where conventional payment methods fail, sovereign commerce infrastructure provides a cost-effective alternative. With the Edge Commerce Stack ($197), transaction fees are minimized, and creators can utilize blockchain networks like BSC or Solana, which have transaction costs under $0.10, making it a financially viable option for consistent cash flow.
Sovereign commerce infrastructure enables true ownership of your digital assets.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

One of the critical differentiators between traditional platforms and sovereign commerce infrastructure is ownership. With services like Lemon Squeezy or Stripe, creators are often beholden to the platform's terms and limitations. In contrast, using the Edge Commerce Stack, creators fully own their digital assets, including the store and customer data. Automation tools facilitate seamless delivery of products upon payment, eliminating manual processes and ensuring that customers receive their purchases immediately. This level of control empowers creators to build sustainable businesses without fear of platform intervention or restrictions.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

Choosing the right architecture largely depends on your specific needs and the restrictions you face. If you are located in a country where Stripe or Lemon Squeezy is unavailable, leveraging the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) is a compelling option. It provides a complete framework for launching an online store quickly, with built-in payment processing through NOWPayments. On the other hand, if you need documentation and guidance, the Sovereign Blueprint at $47 offers comprehensive insights into setting up various stacks. Ultimately, the decision should be based on the level of control, ownership, and ease of use you desire, ensuring that your digital product sales are not hindered by external factors.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

If Stripe is not available in your country, consider using sovereign commerce infrastructure solutions like the Edge Commerce Stack. It allows you to deploy your own digital store with automated payment processing using cryptocurrencies, eliminating reliance on restricted platforms. This provides a sustainable solution for creators facing payment processing challenges.
Say goodbye to platform restrictions and hello to global commerce.

The search for platform alternatives ends when you stop looking for a better platform and start building infrastructure you own. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 deploys Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments under your accounts in 48 hours — no platform relationship involved at any layer after setup. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 gives you the complete build documentation for both stacks if you prefer to deploy yourself. Either path results in a store that cannot be restricted by any payment platform's geographic coverage decision. See both options at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Stop using a friend's account in another country — this violates platform terms and puts both accounts at risk. Create a NOWPayments merchant account under your own email — no KYC required, takes under 15 minutes. Configure wallet addresses for USDT on Tron as your primary coin and Bitcoin as your secondary. Deploy your backend — Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script Web App — and confirm the endpoint URL is accessible. Set the endpoint URL as the webhook URL in your NOWPayments IPN settings with the secret key configured in both places. Build or deploy your storefront on Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages. Run a mainnet test transaction — send a small amount of real USDT to your configured address, confirm the webhook fires, the order logs, and the delivery email arrives. Promote your store only after the complete test passes.
